name: Fey'lya's Pride
description: Fey'lya's Pride was the name of Borsk Fey'lya's personal Lambda-class shuttle, which he used during the Galactic Civil War. It was aboard this shuttle that Fey'lya escorted a single Bothan escaping from the planet Kothlis with a stolen supercomputer that contained the detailed plans and location of the construction of the Death Star II during the Battle of Kothlis.
